idea-plugin.name: Identity Braces
idea-plugin.description:
Every brace gets its own colour out of 32, and a few of them develop personalities.

Rainbow-brace plugins make a matching pair share a colour, so code is easier to read. Identity Braces does the opposite: a brace's colour, name and personality are a stable hash of the line that declares it, so the same brace is the same person every time you open the file — and in Visual Studio and VS Code too, where the same extension exists.

Eighty-six traits: cat ears and thigh highs, wizard hats, a brace that flees the caret, one that sulks when the build fails, one that occasionally flips a table into the empty space beside it. Colour by nesting depth, a scope spotlight and coloured indent guides are there for anyone who would like some of the readability back.

The file on disk is never modified. A brace drawn as ? is still a { in the document; everything here is a rendering-layer illusion.

Works in every JetBrains IDE: IntelliJ IDEA, Rider, CLion, WebStorm, PyCharm, GoLand and the rest. The scanner is its own C-family lexer, so it needs no language plugin.
